title: The Clarke tangent and normal cones to decomposable sets in Lebesgue spaces
summary: Let $(T,Σ,μ)$ be a complete, $σ$-finite measure space, let $Y,Z$ be a separable Banach spaces, and let $S : T \rightrightarrows Z$ be a measurable multifunction with nonempty closed values. We study the relation between the Clarke tangent cone to the decomposable set $\mathsf{Sel}_p(S):=\{x \in L^p(T,Z) : x(t) \in S(t) \hspace{0.1cm} \text{a.e.}\}$ and the $L^p$-selections of the pointwise Clarke tangent cones.
